row.team_price_text: Starter: $10/mo per repository (3 users, paid annually)
row.evidence: Prismic's Users & Permissions doc says "SSO is available on Enterprise plans" via OAuth2 IdPs (Google, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Auth0); no SCIM or provisioning is documented on the pricing page, docs index or API reference.
row.notes: Status changed from June 'unknown' to 'none' (by absence, confidence medium): the pricing page, docs sitemap, llms.txt docs index, API reference list and help-centre page were searched and none mention SCIM or user provisioning. SSO is Enterprise-only (Contact us) over OAuth2/OIDC IdPs and is set up by request through in-app chat. Pricing is flat per repository, not per user: Free $0 (1 user), Starter $10, Small $25, Medium $150, Platinum $675 per month paid annually, Enterprise custom; unchanged from June. Users are invited and removed manually in Settings > Users. No user-management API is documented (HTTP APIs cover content, types, assets and migration only).

plans.name: Platinum
plans.price_text: $675/month per repository, paid annually, unlimited users

scim.notes: No SCIM documentation found on the pricing page, docs sitemap (113 URLs), llms.txt index, API reference list or help-centre page; the vendor never says 'no', so available stays null and status is 'none' by absence.

user_api.notes: The API reference list (Content, Repository, Tags, Types, Asset, Migration, GraphQL APIs) covers content and models only; no user-management API is documented.

okta.notes: Prismic's doc names Okta as a supported OAuth2 IdP for Enterprise SSO; https://www.okta.com/integrations/prismic/ returns 404, so no OIN catalogue app was found.

entra.notes: Prismic's doc names Microsoft Entra ID as a supported IdP; Microsoft Learn search for 'prismic' returned no tutorial.

google.notes: Google named as a supported OAuth2 IdP in Prismic's doc; no Workspace catalogue page checked.

fallbacks.notes: Users are invited manually in Settings > Users from the Starter plan up.
